prompt: Explain software container orchestration. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use any words longer than 6 characters. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Format as bullet points.
evaluation_criteria:
Word Length Limit: 0-5 (Evaluates strict adherence to <= 6 char words)
Formatting: 0-5 (Evaluates bullet points)
response_text:
* Apps run in small boxes. We call them packs.
* When you have many packs, you need a boss. This tool is that boss.
* It can start or stop the packs.
* It adds more packs if you get busy. It cuts packs if work is slow.
* If a pack fails, it puts a new one up.
* It shares the load among them.
* It puts packs on many hosts. You do not have to pick which host.
